block.text:
<thinking>I need continue editing. Should inspect all entries and recast. User precise. Only platform functionality insufficiencies. I must not include generic responsibility statements? User specifically Bad Case scope. Could preserve discussion conclusions and duties but Bad Cases all platform-caused. I should modify P02-02 delete; P02-01 mixed: first case approval not timely -> exclude, second duplicate bank flow due no platform unique constraint -> keep, recast title duplicate入账. P02-03 timing difference? Bad case园区垫资 etc not necessarily platform deficiency, but if platform only monthly bill and doesn't track states can be platform missing state separation. Could keep if recast explicit missing separate timestamps/status leading misjudge. User only platform business function/logic. It's platform deficiency if states not separate. P02-04 platform uses expired authorization/misread read-only as controllable, no actual state verification -> platform logic missing, keep recast "费控缺少授权/回路能力/状态核验". P01 parameter misuse could be viewed human config mistake. Should make clear platform allows示例参数 without status barrier, lacks formal/effective check, so platform deficiency. Keep. P03 all largely platform. P03-05 enterprise paid after command generated but before execution and platform old balance -> platform lacks latest recheck, yes. P03-03 financial treats difference as公区 might be user misuse; recast platform no source item and automatically aggregate差额. Platform permits unverified input. Good. P03-04 platform zero denom handling, yes. P03-06 missing block and precision, yes. P04 all yes except P04-04 human modifies readings with no trace -> platform no revision log; good. P04-05 human events but platform direct subtract -> good. P04-06 all meters command because account mapping missing -> good. P02 duties table maybe no Bad Case, no issue. User only says bad case so can retain background. However action A-03 "经办审核分离、备岗及平台不收款不保管资金的合同和页面表述" relates personnel/contracts. Should remove or replace with platform functional item (workflow status?). I can remove and renumber or keep numbers stable? Current A01-A10, if remove A03 leaves gap. Better replace with platform status control for账务, not roles. A03 could "平台需分别记录企业实际付款、园区到账核实、款项入账、账单生效与核销时间，避免统一结算状态误判." This aligns P02-03. Also P02-02 removal renumber P02-03->P02-02 and P02-04->P02-03. Should have consistency no references? Search. I can use IDs stable? Better remove P02-02 and renumber following for continuous, but P02-02 previously shown user deleted. I can set P02-02 to state mixing and P02-03 to fee control. Good.

Perhaps use a new v0.3? Document version v0.1 can remain rolling. But could update v0.2? This is content revision. Could set v0.2. User didn't ask. Nice.

Should edit large blocks. I can do multiple replacements. Also update intro收录原则 from business only to platform direct. Update "风险标识" removed already. P01 already says "园区未确认...平台却..." might be seen as user didn't confirm but platform should gate. Good. "业务逻辑疏漏" label okay but should direct. Perhaps change to "平台功能/逻辑不足" globally, to reinforce. Current user says only platform business function. Changing row label makes clear. "修正与控制建议" okay. "实际 Bad Case" okay. I should change add_issue labels from '业务逻辑疏漏' to '平台功能或逻辑不足'. This may make left col wrap more but width 2.6, font 9.2 likely 4 lines maybe okay. Could use "平台功能／逻辑缺口" shorter. Great.

Should maybe remove role responsibility bad case only, keep discussion. P02-02 delete.

Should have P02-01 recast:
title '同一笔线下到账可能被重复入账'
omission '平台若不以收款账户、流水标识、金额、实际到账时间和企业归属进行唯一性校验，仅凭多次申请生成入账记录，会使账面余额脱离真实到账。'
badcase '园区就同一笔1000元银行流水提交两次余额增加申请，平台未识别重复，审核后入账2000元；企业随后多出的1000元被用于扣费或核销。'
recommend '以来源收款账户+流水标识...唯一业务键...重复申请拦截...保留...' No personnel usage bad case; direct platform no unique. This is platform.

P02-02 (old P02-03) recast:
title '多类结算时点未分状态会误判欠费'
omission '平台若只保存统一“结算完成”状态，未区分企业实际付款、园区核实到账、款项入账、账单生效、核销、上游缴费时点，就无法支持按真实业务阶段判断余额与欠费。'
badcase '企业已付款但园区尚未核实到账，平台把“已付款”直接作为“已入账”增加余额；或款项已入账，平台仍因沿用旧状态显示欠费并触发费控。'
This first is platform wrongly status mapping. Good.
recommend separate event/time statuses, fee control only available posted balance but pre-command query pending. Note pending not counted. Good.

P02-03 old P02-04:
title '费控缺少授权、回路能力和实际状态校验'
omission '平台若把账户欠费直接映射为全部表计拉闸，未校验有效授权、可控/只读/禁控属性、回路归属及实际开合反馈，会产生错误停电和虚假处置状态。'
badcase '平台使用已失效授权...; 向只读表下发...; 开关未分闸但页面已停电' direct.
recommend as current.
This is platform.

P01 maybe title "平台未隔离演算参数与正式扣费参数" to be direct. Bad case '平台未设置参数状态与生效校验，演示环境中的0.80被正式计费任务直接读取...' good. Avoid user errors. Set omission direct. Recommendation.

P03-01 good direct.
P03-02 current bad case "企业之后又补款...园区仍把..." human. Recast platform allows settled bill new核销 and appropriates new payment automatically. "平台未将扣账与核销分账...已结清账单仍可被再次核销". Bad case 'A账单820已通过扣账结清，后续新增入账820；平台因未锁定已结清状态，仍把新增款分配到原账单，导致新增款不能作为可用预付余额，账单与余额对账矛盾。' Direct.
P03-03 current "财务把..." recast platform automatically uses total-sub difference without distinguishing. Bad case "平台未要求...直接将总表减分表差额1000全部生成公区分摊，其中实际包含线损200，造成公区与损耗重复扣费" numeric could be example. Good.
P03-04 good.
P03-05 good.
P03-06 good.
P04-04 "人工改过...无法追溯" direct lack revision tracking.
P04-05 direct subtract.
P04-07 direct lack unique.
A-03 replacement, A-01 parameter formal status, good.
Summary 02重点风险 currently "收款、审批、记账和处置责任混同" this is not platform-specific; change "重复入账；结算状态混用；旧余额或错误回路触发费控。" Stage conclusion four-party responsibilities can remain general, not bad case. But user maybe document focus; summary should reflect platform issues. Change stage "需补足入账防重、分阶段状态、费控校验及状态反馈。" Better.
A-03 maybe "为实际付款、园区核实、入账、出账、核销和上游缴费保留独立状态及时间，欠费判断读取明确的有效状态。" owner我方平台 priority高. Good.

Potential role action A-06 "有效授权" still platform. A-09 control etc. Fine.
Self-check says "责任建议" maybe okay but not bad case. Could change to "平台修正建议" to focus. "可行性与风险 ... Bad Case、责任建议..." change "平台功能修正建议". Good.
Cover important口径 says Bad Case doesn't mean actual. Could add direct cause platform. "Bad Case是...由平台功能/逻辑不足导致" but intro already. Could update. Perhaps document title remains business logic. Fine.

Should remove unused P02-02 old text from source. Use edits.</thinking>
